g.text: Thin lines = individual seeds; bold lines = three-seed means. Startup CE is about 10.8. Lines connect the actual sparse observations.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64717a

g.text: Validation uses the same 10 sampled batches at each log; training uses one noisy minibatch. These are not full-validation EMA curves.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64717a

g.text: Dotted lines: configured cooldown/EMA start, 800 for short runs and 2,000 for long GQA. D256 is descriptive, with unmatched MLA/GQA seeds.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64717a

g.text: No MLA 3,000-update curve is available in these comparison campaigns. Improving through 1,200 does not establish resistance to later overfitting.
